# OS architecture

- microkernel
- capabilities
- single syscall
- userspace scheduler
- all "servers" in userspace

# IDL (exports)

```
local interface log_v1
{
    ## The io-channel the lines travel on: a control page and two data pages
    ## (32 lines in flight).
    channel 2;

    ## Every function receives the badge of the key it was called through.
    badged;

    ## Tell the server lines were put: it looks at every client's channel
    ## soon after. Never waits; the server also looks on its own every few
    ## milliseconds, so a line put without a `flush` is written too.
    flush();
}
```

# IDL (imports)

```
uses mailbox_v1 via device compatible "raspberrypi,bcm2835-firmware", mboxes { set_led }
uses power_v1 via device compatible "brcm,bcm2835-pm" { reset }
uses compositor_v1 via component compositor { pixel_order, create_window, commit, move_window, raise, destroy, snapshot }
```

# Support components

- heap - rlsf-based allocation
- audio - sample playback and mixing
- midi_synth - MIDI playback
- dispatcher - called by kernel timer tick
- compositor - windows and input events
- usb/usb-core/usb-hid - USB stack
- log_server - logging

# Tooling

- if_lsp - LSP for interface files
- chainboot - chain bootloader for rpi
- chainofcommand - control plain for chain boot

# Wood

doom-generic ported to Rust - "Room"
then Room rewritten to more idiomatic rust (no ptr(), almost no unsafe)
platform code extracted into a trait
